Game Overview

In Whack a Mouse, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your reflexes in Whack a Mouse, a zany arcade experience. Catch the elusive mouse as it teases and evades you, but be swift—each round cranks up the speed. Packed with comical animations and a playful vibe, it's a lighthearted challenge that promises endless laughter and high-score thrills.
